scope: Development comparison on dynamic RGB-D footage; no novelty or DNF claim
selection: First 90 chronological RGB frames at stride 3, selected before depth or reference association. All twelve fixed-grid image tracks retained. No scene or track substitution based on outcome.
settings: Same pinned checkpoints and inference settings as the preceding static and office comparisons: DAGE float16 252px; DA3 252px query-chunk 256. Save full-clip predictions and record all attempts.
score: Frozen classical coordinate reprojection-error bisection, native published Freiburg-3 calibration, frames 1..89, median bounds over all twelve tracks; unresolved scores [0,infinity]. No reference poses, depth values, or semantic masks used for scoring.
validation: Separate reference-pose validation after geometric scores are saved. Same frame roster for both methods, nearest reference within 20ms; report unavailable association rather than substitute frames. Sim3-aligned ATE and adjacent-frame RPE. These are not functional failure labels.
purpose: Add a real moving-object scene before comparing learned versus classical image evidence. This stage establishes method outputs and the baseline, not a learned evaluator's advantage.
limitations: Development scene used previously with DAGE, not held out. Moving-object tracks are not assumed static. No human agreement, DNF cutoff, or superiority claim follows from this pair. DA3 query-chunk end-to-end equivalence remains unestablished. Preserve attempts outside the manuscript.
